import importlib.metadata
import os
import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

counts_path, metadata_path = sys.argv[1:3]
n_cpus = max(1, int(os.environ.get("GALAXY_SLOTS", "1")))

counts = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
metadata = pd.read_csv(metadata_path)

if "sample" not in metadata.columns:
    raise ValueError("Metadata must contain a sample column")
for col in ("batch", "sex"):
    if col not in metadata.columns:
        raise ValueError(f"Metadata must contain {col}")

counts.index = counts.index.astype(str)
counts.columns = counts.columns.astype(str)
if counts.index.has_duplicates:
    raise ValueError("Count matrix has duplicate gene identifiers")
if counts.columns.has_duplicates:
    raise ValueError("Count matrix has duplicate sample identifiers")

metadata["sample"] = metadata["sample"].astype(str)
if metadata["sample"].duplicated().any():
    raise ValueError("Metadata has duplicate sample identifiers")
metadata = metadata.set_index("sample", drop=True)

missing_metadata = sorted(set(counts.columns) - set(metadata.index))
missing_counts = sorted(set(metadata.index) - set(counts.columns))
if missing_metadata or missing_counts:
    raise ValueError(
        f"Sample mismatch: missing_metadata={missing_metadata[:5]}, "
        f"missing_counts={missing_counts[:5]}"
    )
metadata = metadata.loc[counts.columns].copy()

counts = counts.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="raise")
count_array = counts.to_numpy()
if not np.isfinite(count_array).all():
    raise ValueError("Count matrix contains non-finite values")
if (count_array < 0).any():
    raise ValueError("Count matrix contains negative values")
if not np.equal(count_array, np.floor(count_array)).all():
    raise ValueError("Count matrix contains non-integer values")
counts = counts.astype(np.int64)

metadata["batch"] = pd.Categorical(
    metadata["batch"].astype(str),
    categories=["1", "2", "3", "4"],
    ordered=True,
)
metadata["sex"] = pd.Categorical(
    metadata["sex"].astype(str),
    categories=["F", "M"],
    ordered=True,
)
if metadata["batch"].isna().any() or metadata["sex"].isna().any():
    raise ValueError("Unexpected batch or sex level in metadata")

dds = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts,
    metadata=metadata,
    design="~ batch + sex",
    n_cpus=n_cpus,
    quiet=True,
)
dds.deseq2()

stat_res = DeseqStats(
    dds,
    contrast=["sex", "M", "F"],
    n_cpus=n_cpus,
    quiet=True,
)
stat_res.summary()

coefficients = [str(c) for c in stat_res.LFC.columns]
sex_coefficients = [
    c for c in coefficients
    if c.startswith("sex[") and c.endswith("M]")
]
if len(sex_coefficients) != 1:
    raise ValueError(f"Could not identify unique M sex coefficient: {coefficients}")
stat_res.lfc_shrink(coeff=sex_coefficients[0])

results = stat_res.results_df.copy()
results.index = results.index.astype(str)
results.index.name = "gene_id"
results = results.reset_index()
results = results[
    ["gene_id", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat", "pvalue", "padj"]
]
results.to_csv(
    "pydeseq2_apeglm_shrunken_results.tsv",
    sep="\t",
    index=False,
    na_rep="NA",
    float_format="%.15g",
)
